title: A Rwandan death toll is not stored
summary: The tribunal page we opened did not state a number of people killed.
body: Public accounts of the 1994 genocide in Rwanda often cite a death toll around 800,000 in about one hundred days. The IRMCT page opened for this pack dated the plane and used the word genocide, and it did not state a toll. Leave the number unsourced until it is copied from a named demographic or judicial source.
